value.basis: COST_RATIO.md self-declares it was written before any sweep result was produced or read (only the label file opened); not hash-pinned; first committed 14:02 (1ddfa4e), after e9d9449 (12:21, v1 metrics) and 2044eb8 (13:16, results.json with R=10). Cost model C_fa vs C_miss from NASA OTPS 2023 labour/outage/loss values, ESA alert volumes and Swarm-B timeline, CARA 2x late delta-v. Central R=6.0 (C_fa EUR 1,120, C_miss EUR 6,750). Monte Carlo 200k draws: P10 2.4, P50 5.1, P90 10.3. R=10 = ~P90, chosen because the user prioritises catching criticals. A miss = late discovery, not a collision (mean final Pc of critical events 6.1e-6). At R>=14 'flag everything' beats 'flag nothing', so R>=20 not supported.

Add risk engine, offline pipeline, forecaster registry and live-sky screening

Use TypeSafe's official Jev API as the primary decision model
Evaluate on the organizer's official label set and population
Serve the organizer-trained forecaster; add model search results and docs
Hand-drawn dark ggplot-style charts, statistics tab and integration fixes
Keep ops.log clear of the wider chart inspector
Stream per-axis CDM sigmas and shade ±1σ on the RTN chart
